en: Welcome one and all. The goal of this{SAUT}special screening is...

The whole request seems odd.{OPTION}Has Marie been inspired?
It seems she's been intrigued by Hikari's{SAUT}movie ever since she saw those flowers.{PAGE}Recently, she's been in a poetic slump,{SAUT}and so craves stimulation.

There you have it. Would you mind{SAUT}taking Marie along with you for this{SAUT}screening?

Yes, she'll certainly feel more of this{SAUT}"pathos" if she goes in person, no?
I have already seen how capable you{SAUT}are. I hold no worries of her safety if she{SAUT}is with you.
I-It's nothing important... You don't{SAUT}have to do it if you don't want to...

Well then, good luck out there to{SAUT}everyone, Marie included.
